Griffin (CV 28)

A great winged predator with an eagle’s head and forequarters joined to a powerful feline body. Sharp talons and broad wings suit it to cliffs and open hunting ground.

Attributes: Brawn +2; Fortitude +2; Agility +2; Guile +0; Knowledge -2; Reason +1

HP: 30 · Speed: 6; fly 10 · Size: 2 (2x2 squares) · Armor DR: 0

Evasion: 1 Bane · Threat: 1 Bane · Stability: 1

Weaknesses: None\ Resistances: None\ Immunities: None

Actions

Damage and effects are Weak / Standard / Strong player defense. Each slash separates one complete outcome. All attacks use the printed Threat unless stated otherwise.

Details

Diving talons

It gathers itself, then arrives in a rush of claws and weight.

Target: One adjacent creature. Player defense: Agility. Damage type: physical.

Weak defense: After moving 2 toward target, Prone. Standard defense: After moving 2 toward target, Prone.

Hooked beak

The hooked beak finds purchase while the wings hold the creature steady.

Target: One adjacent creature. Player defense: Fortitude. Damage type: physical.

Weak defense: Bleeding 2. Standard defense: Bleeding 1.

Bank Away

A struck feather spins loose as the great wings tilt and carry the creature out of the firing line.

After a ranged attack resolves and deals HP damage to this creature, fly up to 2 squares using its printed fly speed. Pay normal terrain costs, provoke normally and finish in a legal position. This creature must survive and remain capable of flight. No trigger from a free attack; no attack or automatic lift of a held creature.

Wing Step

A single hard wingbeat carries it toward a better angle.

Move up to 2 squares using its printed fly speed without provoking from one visible enemy chosen before moving. Pay normal terrain costs and provoke normally from other enemies. This grants no attack, automatic lift of another creature or hovering exception.

General details

Basic Melee: One adjacent creature; physical damage; Agility defense. Uses the printed Threat. No specialty riders.

Defend: Player attacks suffer 1 additional Bane until the start of its next turn. Combines with Evasion through normal Boon/Bane rules. Repeated Defend does not stack.

Opportunity Attack: Basic Melee against the provoking creature. Spends its Reaction before the provoking action resolves. That action continues if the creature remains capable.

Heavy Frame — Passive: Stability 1; an explicit creature trait, not a bonus from size.

Healing: Living: ordinary HP healing applies.

Senses: Ordinary sight and hearing.

Signs: Large feathers and clean-picked hooves lie below a high ledge.

Purpose: Feed its young and keep the nesting cliff secure.

Tactics and retreat: Dive into a pounce, then defend the landing place; flight does not supply extra attacks.

Counterplay and conversation: Shelter mounts under a roof or offer food away from the nest.

Habitat: Cliff; highland · Communication: None

Loot: A nest may contain one valuable lost saddle or traveler’s pack.

Summoning: Ineligible.

Design notes — not needed during play

ID: creature-griffin

Category: Beast · Role: Flying predator · CV: 28

CV worksheet

Difficulty rationale: An agile or elusive body warrants attack Banes. Its dangerous attack imposes defense Banes.

Reference damage: 4/6/8

Reference type: physical

Expected targets: 1

Utility factor: 1.5

Action review (#1279): U 1.35 → 1.5: Maneuver allowance +0.05, Reaction allowance +0.1. These are provisional judgments for the changed capabilities, counting the largest increment in each category rather than adding every alternative. Reactions compete for one budget; no measured balance claim.

Regeneration per turn: 0
